note: The store builds in readers' hands, and the commit each was cut from. The website runs ahead of them (his word, 2026-11-28: "keep the website public on v2.0 and drop mobile in announcement update batches"), so every push to main is held to these by scripts/apps-compat.mjs: nothing the apps fetch from the website may go missing or change under them. When a store serves a new build, add it here with its commit and build numbers (Android's versionCode and iOS's build number are their workflow run numbers); take an old one off only when no reader can still be on it.
